description: This file defines a service for aggregating hierarchical LLM (Large Language Model) costs, including functions for data normalization, aggregation pipeline construction, and index management in a MongoDB collection.

methods.name: projectionStage
methods.description: Creates a MongoDB projection stage to normalize and extract relevant fields from the llm_costs collection.

methods.name: addDateKeyStage
methods.description: Adds a date object to the pipeline, converting string dates to Date objects.

methods.name: projectDateKeyStage
methods.description: Projects the normalized fields and formats the date as a string for grouping.

methods.name: groupByAgentDateStage
methods.description: Aggregates data by user, project, agent, and date, summing costs and tokens.

methods.name: groupAgentTotalsStage
methods.description: Summarizes agent data across dates, calculating total costs and organizing costs and tokens by date.

methods.name: agentProjectStage
methods.description: Projects agent-level summaries with formatted costs and tokens.

methods.name: groupProjectStage
methods.description: Aggregates data at the project level, including associated agents.

methods.name: projectProjectStage
methods.description: Projects project-level summaries with total costs and agents.

methods.name: groupUserStage
methods.description: Aggregates data at the user level, including all projects.

methods.name: finalProjectStage
methods.description: Projects the final user-level aggregate with total cost and list of projects.

methods.name: aggregateHierarchy
methods.description: Main function to perform hierarchical aggregation of LLM costs from MongoDB, returning formatted results.

methods.name: ensureLlmCostsIndexes
methods.description: Creates indexes on the llm-costs collection to optimize query performance.
